reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Kareem Amin, co-founder and CEO of Clay.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Kareem Amin, co-founder and CEO of Clay. Clay has become one of the fastest-growing software companies of the last few years, valued at over four billion dollars. It helps companies find their best customers and reach them at scale.

key_points.text: But this conversation is about a lot more than Clay.
Kareem is one of the most original thinkers I know.
We talk about the statues he keeps at the center of how he runs Clay — truth, justice.
